how: "Read by the office" -> "Closed" needs no site visit.
detail: A reason is required, the move is in the audit log, and the daily digest names every close without a visit. Guard: `tests/api/test_alerts.py::test_a_verdict_or_a_close_without_a_visit_needs_a_note`.

title: Someone with database access edits or deletes a past audit entry
detail: The database refuses UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE on the log; with the guard switched off, the hash chain check names the first broken entry. Guard: `tests/api/test_alerts.py::test_the_chain_check_finds_an_entry_changed_or_removed_behind_the_triggers`.

title: Scoring MPs by their history
how: Considered and rejected: lighter checks for "low-risk" MPs, a cold start for new ones, a loop feeding on its own flags.
detail: Never scored (AGENTS.md rule 5): works, offices and agencies only; no MP's name ever reaches a work's record from the form. Guard: `tests/cost_form/test_pswif.py::test_the_work_record_carries_the_form_and_never_an_mp_name`.

title: A data reload erasing what people saved
how: load_db emptied the works; saved cost forms and site visits point at them, so the reload failed, and CASCADE would have erased them.
detail: Works are replaced in place; a work with a saved form or visit is never deleted. Guard: `tests/test_reload.py`.

title: A final video moved a work's start to the completion day
how: The reason read "complete 0 days after the work could start" instead of counting from the sanction.
detail: A final video never sets the start. Guard: `tests/agents/time_rules/test_time_rules_t168.py::test_a_final_video_never_moves_the_start_the_pace_is_counted_from`.

title: The form page gave a wrong reason when Cost could not check
how: After a rate change Cost waits for a reason (the total differs from the MP's amount); the page said "No prices to compare with".
detail: The page shows the agent's own reason and the missing answer. Guard: `start-to-end browser check (T170 log)`.

title: The live demo check judged examples on the wrong day
how: Examples were judged on the data's snapshot day, not their own (6 of 13 wrong live).
detail: The demo check uses the examples' own day (demo.as_of). Guard: `data/trial/work_form_examples.py (stops when the demo path differs)`.
